hacker-zone-of-powerlessness-selected-ar.head: 6267d5ba22bf0a9ae756ce2d7463ac3737f62c33
hacker-zone-of-powerlessness-selected-ar.scope: Stock PR905 at level 30 and legal 47/60 Hacker loadout. The selected hostile and 8.00 m edge alone received 399 state 96 and its linked marker for 6.54 s, with paired removal. Two-second cast, 30 IS, 30 s own reuse, no health damage and no independent source 734. PR856 separately proved empty and friendly selection refusal before cost. Authored base is 6 s. The original inputs for the archived 9.9 s and 10.14 s duration records remain unresolved.

hacker-plague-zone-one-selected-viral-do.head: ce654e8d547ec7b43f8b1aa86553991cb337156a
hacker-plague-zone-one-selected-viral-do.scope: Stock at level 30 with the verified 47/60 Hacker Style closure. No-target and same-organization requests refused reason 24 before cost. Cast 2 s, reuse 12 s, paid 15 IS. Only the selected hostile and exact 5.00 m edge received source 400 stat 1157 +74 for 15 s with five twelve-point ticks, then removal and no sixth tick. The 5.01 m hostile and ally were excluded. Helper regen obscured cumulative HP, so the direct controlled health proof comes from DespoilerFieldsLandOnTheSelectedEnemyAndExactRadiusEdge.

behavior-tests.source: GOB 399 specifies a selected hostile, at-rest Hacker cast, 30 IS, a two-second cast, 30 s own reuse and a six-second Powerless record without an immunity callback.
behavior-tests.runtime: AbilityCatalog.Controls supplies the stored base. The current duration calculation applies the caster's loaded influence.
